candidates.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
candidates.reason: Seminal large-model training systems work: practical intra-layer model parallelism with measured scaling efficiency. It fills an important foundation gap for distributed LLM training.

candidates.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
candidates.reason: Introduces Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE; MLA directly targets inference KV-cache footprint and the report quantifies large cache and throughput effects.

candidates.title: SARATHI: Efficient LLM Inference by Piggybacking Decodes with Chunked Prefills
candidates.reason: Focused LLM inference-system paper combining chunked prefills and decode-maximal batching to reduce prefill/decode interference and pipeline bubbles.

candidates.title: Accelerating Large Language Model Decoding with Speculative Sampling
candidates.reason: Foundational speculative-decoding method providing lossless acceleration through draft generation plus corrected acceptance/rejection sampling.

candidates.title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
candidates.reason: Foundational practical LLM post-training weight quantization work with direct memory-capacity and end-to-end inference-speed implications.
